title: Problem
description: Every non-2xx response from the kernel API (RFC 9457 problem details, application/problem+json). The UI chooses its state component from `status` and `code` (see design board States).

type.description: URI reference naming the problem type, e.g. https://aos.local/problems/stale_version

title.description: Short, human sentence safe to show as a heading.

detail.description: Plain-language explanation safe to show to the signed-in person. Never contains data above their clearance.

trace_id.description: OpenTelemetry trace ID of the failed request; shown on the ErrorBanner.

decision_id.description: Policy or Decision Record behind a refusal (codes policy_*, segregation_of_duties).

rule.description: Policy rule that decided a refusal, e.g. requester_never_sees_quotes.

current_version.description: For stale_version and already_claimed: the version the client must reload.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer into the request body, e.g. /content/quantity
